title: Rhinoplasty Covered Diagnoses
description: ICD-10-CM diagnoses listed in question 2.1, Primary Diagnosis, of the approved Rhinoplasty prior authorization mapping spreadsheet. This ValueSet is the eligibility gate. Local Other and NA response codes are intentionally excluded because they are questionnaire response values, not ICD-10-CM diagnoses.
